# Memory — schema_semantic_constrained_ie

## 文献调研 (2026-05-13)

### 核心结论: OntoCoDec 的 novelty 成立
**没有人做过 "compile IE ontology domain/range → decoding-time logits masking" 的完整 pipeline。**

Gap 结构：
- Syntactic constrained decoding for IE: well-explored (GCD, XGrammar, Outlines)
- Vocabulary-level: exists (GENRE, iNERD, AdaKGC)
- **Semantic (domain/range) decoding for IE: OPEN GAP** ← OntoCoDec
- Semantic type checking at decode time: only for code gen (MGD NeurIPS'23, PLDI'25)
- Ontology compliance for IE: only post-processing (ODKE+ Apple'25, OntoLogX'25)

最近竞争者：PLDI'25 Type-Constrained Code Gen（同机制但领域是代码生成，必须引用并区分）

风险：CRANE (ICML'25) 严格约束可能降低推理质量；Grammar-Aligned Decoding (NeurIPS'24) naive masking 扭曲分布

Novelty 定位："OntoCoDec 将 type-constrained generation 引入信息抽取，编译 IE ontology axioms 为解码时语义约束，预防而非检测 type violations。"

详细报告: `artifacts/literature_map.yaml`, `artifacts/literature_survey_*.md`

## 实验发现

### 🎯 W5 LoRA Composability — Qwen 完全验证 (2026-05-15) ⚠️ 论文核心新增 claim

**Fine-tuning + OntoCoDec 正交可组合，互补消除 schema violations。**

完整 2×2 矩阵（SciERC, Qwen3-8B）：

| | Unconstrained | Constrained (OntoCoDec) | ΔDR | ΔR-F1 |
|--|--|--|--|--|
| Base | DR=15.37%, R-F1=8.23% | DR=0.93%, R-F1=8.36% | -94% | +0.13pp |
| Fine-tuned (LoRA) | DR=1.95%, R-F1=43.86% | DR=0.0%, R-F1=43.77% | -100% | -0.09pp |

关键 insights：
- Fine-tuning 将 DR 15.37%→1.95% (内化 87% 约束)，但 tight-constraint 长尾 (Evaluate-for 13.1%) 无法覆盖
- OntoCoDec 消除剩余 1.95% → 0.00%，零 F1 代价 (-0.09pp)
- CF 从 base constrained 9.90% → fine-tuned constrained 1.18% (-8.72pp)
- E-F1 +36pp, R-F1 +35pp——回应"只适用于 prompting"质疑
- LoRA 训练仅 688s (~11.5min), rank=16, 3 epochs, token_acc=98.16%

### 🎯 W5 LoRA Composability — Llama 跨模型验证 (2026-05-15) ⚠️ 论文核心

|--|--|--|--|--|
| Zero-shot | DR=13.34%, R-F1=2.68% | DR=0.08%, R-F1=2.54% | -99.4% | -0.14pp |
| Fine-tuned (LoRA) | DR=1.11%, R-F1=45.45% | DR=0.09%, R-F1=45.47% | -91.9% | +0.02pp |

关键 insights：
- FT 内化 92% 约束 (13.34%→1.11%)，OntoCoDec 消除剩余 → 0.09%
- R-F1 零代价 (+0.02pp)，E-F1 完全持平 (67.76%)
- CF 仅 0.46%（Llama FT 后 CF 远低于 Qwen base 9.90%）
- 跨模型一致：Qwen DR=0.0% / Llama DR=0.09%，证明 model-agnostic
